resources.string: Only One is a minimalist chat app where you can send exactly one message per person per day. Discover new people in Swipe mode, read their short status, and open a conversation with a single thoughtful note.

• One message per user per day
 • Friends can reply once or react (👍 👎 😐)
 • Swipe random users (25/day free, unlimited for subscribers)
 • Status messages guide the tone
 • Favorites let you keep a meaningful message
Emoji reactions that don’t use up your daily message
Android + Jetpack Compose, Firebase Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Functions, and FCM for notifications.
Questions or feedback? Email support@onlyone.app — we read everything.
